content: SuperOptiX is a framework-agnostic AI agent toolkit that supports DSPy, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, CrewAI, PydanticAI, Google ADK, Microsoft Agent Framework, and DeepAgents. It compiles YAML playbooks into optimized agent pipelines across all major frameworks.

SurrealDB is a multi-model database supporting document, graph, vector, full-text search, key-value, and time-series models in a single engine. It uses SurrealQL for queries and supports RELATE for graph edges, HNSW for vector indexing, and LIVE SELECT for real-time streaming.

Vector search in SurrealDB uses HNSW indexing with cosine, euclidean, or manhattan distance metrics. Embeddings are stored as array fields and queried with vector::similarity::cosine() for semantic similarity ranking.

SurrealDB graph traversal uses RELATE statements to create typed edges between records. The -> and <- operators enable multi-hop traversal, combining structured entity relationships with any other query model in a single SurrealQL statement.

RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) in SuperOptiX retrieves relevant context from vector stores before LLM inference. It supports vector-only, hybrid (vector plus BM25 full-text), graph (vector plus graph traversal), and multi (vector plus full-text plus graph) retrieval modes.

GraphRAG combines vector similarity search with graph traversal to expand retrieval context by following entity relationships. A vector search finds seed documents, then graph edges are traversed to discover related entities, yielding richer and more structured results than flat vector search alone.
